verdict.rationale: Direct probes confirm Antigravity serves an llms.txt at antigravity.google/llms.txt (HTTP 200, with an agent-oriented product summary) and markdown versions of its docs pages (e.g. getting-started.md returns HTTP 200). An agent can therefore be pointed straight at machine-readable docs. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing or promoting the llms.txt/markdown docs for agent use, evidence of the full llms.txt index coverage or an llms-full.txt, and independent community corroboration of using these docs with agents.
